templates.headline: %s and %s argue over the price of spirit rice
templates.detail: Voices carry across the stalls, and neither will name a fair number first.

templates.headline: %s drills %s until the training yard is dark
templates.detail: The same cut, a hundred times, until the body stops asking why.

templates.headline: %s sits at the shrine until the incense burns out
templates.detail: Whatever the meditation found, it is not being shared.

templates.headline: %s brings in a harvest before the weather turns
templates.detail: The grain is thin this year, but the barn will not be empty.

templates.headline: %s finds beast tracks closer to the gate than last week
templates.detail: The watch has doubled the night rounds and still wants the herd thinned.

templates.headline: %s sells a bolt of cloud silk to a traveller from the next province
templates.detail: The traveller paid in old stones and asked too many questions about the road east.

templates.headline: %s talks of leaving the market before the first snow
templates.detail: It is the third year the same table has heard the same plan.
